use: unit 3 records: record cards, True/False, Pairs and GeoWords clues; disputed records (nile-longest) get the «Есть нюанс» popup and are never used in clues or single-answer exercises
approvalRule: approval.contentSha256 = first 16 hex of sha256 over {id, name, fact, caveat, disputed} (JSON, sorted keys, UTF-8). If any of these change, the approval no longer matches and the card must be re-approved before it is shown (scheme extended 2026-10-24 with Svetlana's consent; texts unchanged).

fact.en: The Nile is usually called the longest river in the world.
fact.ru: Нил обычно называют самой длинной рекой мира.

amazon.alt: up to 6,990 km with another source

caveat.en: Some scientists think the Amazon is longer: its length depends on which stream is taken as its source, and there is no agreement yet.
caveat.ru: Некоторые учёные считают, что Амазонка длиннее: её длина зависит от того, какой ручей считать истоком, и единого мнения пока нет.

fact.en: The Amazon carries the most water of any river.

figure.unit: % of river freshwater to the ocean (up to)

fact.en: The Volga is the longest river in Europe.
The Yangtze is the longest river in Asia.
The Danube flows through or along the borders of more countries than any other river.
fact.ru: Дунай течёт по территории или по границам большего числа стран, чем любая другая река.

fact.en: The Yellow River is famous for its sediment-rich waters and is often called the muddiest river in the world.
fact.ru: Хуанхэ славится водой, богатой наносами, и её часто называют самой мутной рекой мира.

items.source: New World Encyclopedia: Yellow River; sediment load fell from 1.6 billion t/yr (1970s) to about 0.3 billion t/yr (Chinese Academy of Sciences, 2015), so it is given as "often called", not as a current record

categoryRule: record category (Svetlana, 2026-10-24): stable — may be used in GeoWords clues; conditional — only with its criterion in the wording ("often called…"); changing — only with a year (asOf) and never in clues
